title: 第652章 始源大陆不简单第651章 我被碾压了
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
“这不科学吧，我也是养灵大圆满啊……”苏醒背靠微凉的防护光幕，甩动发麻发胀的右臂，心底满是难以平复的错愕与不甘。
他下意识找起了合理的说辞：难不成这家伙是徒手格斗类的职业者，自带固定的职业增幅加持。
方才自己只动用了纯粹肉身与基础内力，没有用剑，全程没有激活剑士职业的专属加成，落败也算情理之中。
对，一定是这样的。
靠着这番心理安抚，躁动的情绪稍稍平复几分。
苏醒不再徒手格斗，手腕一转，‘烟火’已赫然握于掌心，面对乘机攻击过来的对手就是一记【挥砍】。
封岩见状没有丝毫迟疑，脚下大地灵气轰然聚拢，岩土劲气再度凝实加厚，裹挟千钧重压的土黄色重拳再度轰杀而来。
一拳径直对准苏醒的剑锋悍然撞来，俨然一副硬扛兵刃、以力破巧的蛮横打法。
预想之中拳脚相撞的剧烈轰鸣并未如期响起。
苏醒加持了剑士职业增幅，将这一剑的动量提高了近30倍。
封岩那灌注了满身土系灵能、厚重无比的岩土重拳，看似势大力沉，触碰到剑刃的瞬间，坚硬的岩土劲气便如同碎瓷般层层崩裂、剥落。
没有丝毫滞涩，锋利剑势长驱直入，顺着对方拳锋狠狠切入。
下一瞬，整尊敦实健壮的灵能躯体从中剖开，一分为二。
土黄色的灵能灵光漫天炸开，化作星星点点的细碎光点，在擂台护罩内肆意飘散。
漫天土系灵能光粒缓缓飘散消融，擂台的八卦灵纹慢慢归于平静。
苏醒单手握持着烟火长剑，剑尖垂落一缕星光，脸上方才被一拳砸飞的郁闷一扫而空，几分自得攀上眉眼。
他抬眼望向半空悬浮的清源，扬了扬手中佩剑，语气带着几分显摆：“看见没，方才这一剑，够不够利落帅气？”
清源十分识趣，当即拱手奉承：“老爷出手自然风姿卓绝，一击破敌干净利落，这封岩天骄遇到老爷就好像是……”
舒心的夸赞入耳，苏醒心头畅快不少，嘿嘿一笑：“说正经的，这个封岩当年拿下青羽星比武第一，放在整个仙庭天骄序列里，大致是什么排名？还有他隶属于几阶何等位格？”
清源灵体微微晃动，梳理着资料库内封存的档案，缓缓作答：

“封岩在青羽星同辈里已然是顶尖人物。当年他带着这份实力参与仙庭百万生命星球联合大比，止步万人晋级名单，放在整片仙庭的天骄梯队里，只能算作中上游水准。”
“万人圈……”苏醒心头狠狠一震，心底方才升起的自得瞬间被一盆冷水浇灭。
还未等苏醒平复心绪，清源紧接着道出更为颠覆他认知的讯息：“再说职业一事，先前跟随张宗蛰交流时我便有所耳闻。”
“依靠成年觉醒、绑定专属职业获取战力增幅，参加登神仪式，只是始源大陆这片地界独有的环境特性与规则产物。”
content_en:
"This is unscientific, I am also a soul-nourishing Dzogchen..." Su Xing leaned against the cool protective light curtain and shook his numb and swollen right arm. His heart was full of shock and unwillingness that could not be calmed down.
He subconsciously came up with a reasonable excuse: Could it be that this guy is a professional in unarmed combat and has a fixed professional increase blessing?
Just now, I only used my pure physical body and basic internal strength, without using a sword. I did not activate the exclusive bonus of the swordsman profession in the whole process, so the defeat is reasonable.
Yes, that must be the case.
Relying on this psychological comfort, the restless mood calmed down a little.
Su Xing no longer fights with his bare hands. With a turn of his wrist, the 'firework' is clearly in his palm, and he can strike with a [slash] against the opponent who takes the opportunity to attack.
Feng Yan didn't hesitate at all when he saw this, the spiritual energy of the earth suddenly gathered under his feet, the energy of the rock and earth solidified and thickened again, and the heavy earth-yellow fist came again with a heavy pressure.
A punch was aimed directly at the awakening sword, and it was like a arrogant fighting style of carrying the weapon forcefully and using force to overcome skill.
The expected violent roar of fists and feet clashing did not sound as expected.
Awakening has enhanced the swordsman's professional growth, increasing the momentum of this sword by nearly 30 times.
Feng Yan's extremely heavy rock and earth punch, which was filled with earth spiritual energy, seemed to be powerful and heavy. The moment it touched the blade, the hard rock and earth energy cracked and peeled off layer by layer like broken porcelain.
There was no hesitation at all, the sharp sword drove straight in and cut hard along the edge of the opponent's fist.
The next moment, the entire stocky and strong spiritual body was cut open from the middle and divided into two.
The khaki psychic light exploded all over the sky, turning into tiny dots of light that scattered freely within the ring shield.
The earth-type spiritual energy light particles all over the sky slowly dispersed and dissolved, and the Bagua spiritual patterns in the arena slowly returned to calm.
Su Xing held the fireworks sword with one hand, and a ray of starlight fell from the tip of the sword. The depression on his face, which had just been smashed away by a punch, was wiped away, and a sense of contentment appeared on his face.
He raised his eyes to look at Qingyuan floating in the air, raised the sword in his hand, and said in a somewhat showy tone: "Did you see that the sword just now was neat and handsome enough?"
Qingyuan was very sensible and immediately flattered him: "The master is naturally graceful in his attacks and can defeat the enemy with one blow. When Feng Yan Tianjiao meets the master, it's like..."
The comfortable compliments were heard, and Su Xing felt much more at ease. He chuckled: "To be serious, this Feng Yan won the first place in the Qingyu Star competition back then. What is his approximate ranking among the Tianjiao Tianjiao in the entire Immortal Court? And what rank does he belong to?"
Qingyuan's spirit body shook slightly, combing through the files sealed in the database, and answered slowly:
"Feng Yan is already a top figure among his peers in Qingyu Star. Back then, he used this strength to participate in the Immortal Court's Million Life Planet Joint Competition, and stopped ten thousand people from advancing to the list. When placed in the entire Immortal Court's genius echelon, he can only be regarded as an upper-middle level."
"A circle of thousands of people..." Su Xing's heart was shocked, and the complacency that had just risen in his heart was instantly extinguished by a basin of cold water.
Before he could wake up and calm down, Qingyuan then revealed information that even more subverted his cognition: "Let's talk about career. I heard about it when I communicated with Zhang Zongzhe."
"Relying on adult awakening, binding to exclusive professions to obtain combat power increases, and participating in the ascension ceremony are just the products of the unique environmental characteristics and rules of the Origin Continent."
